title: feat(welcome): v3 core architecture — channel resolver, live bus, AI personalization, analytics
body:
## Summary

Establishes the **Core architectural patterns** (config + hot-reload + channel/role API + live bus + test-action) through the Welcome v3 system. Every future module (Moderation, Tickets, Economy) will reuse these patterns.

### Bug fix
`🍑・welcome` channel wasn't being found — `ChannelResolver.normalizeName()` now applies NFKD + emoji-stripping so `🍑・welcome` → `"welcome"` via ASCII-safe comparison.

### New gateway modules
- **`ChannelResolver`** — snowflake-first lookup, fuzzy name fallback via `normalizeName()`, `listTextChannels()/listAssignableRoles()` for API
- **`LiveBus`** — Redis pub/sub ring-buffer for real-time dashboard events (`member:join/leave/verified/quarantined`)
- **`AIWelcome`** — GPT-4o-mini 1-line personalized greeting; 4s timeout, 60-token cap, silent fallback

### WelcomeHandler v3 refactor
```
handleMemberJoin:
  1. generatePersonalizedGreeting() if config.aiPersonalizedEnabled
  2. recordJoinEvent() → JoinEvent doc with priorJoins
  3. applyQuarantineIfSuspicious() if config.quarantineNewAccounts
  4. resolveWelcomeChannel() (emoji-aware)
  5. appendStage('welcomed')
  6. liveBus.broadcast('member:join', {quarantined, returning, …})
  7. sendWelcomeDM() with verification button
```
New `case 'verify'` button handler → assigns `verifiedRoleId`, updates `JoinEvent.verified`.

### Health server → internal API
`/api/discord/channels`, `/api/discord/roles`, `/api/discord/live-events`, `POST /api/welcome/test`

### Dashboard
- Channel/role dropdown pickers (live from gateway)
- Theme preset picker (Cyber / Gold / Halloween / Christmas / Minimal / Custom)
- Quarantine / AI / Returning-member toggles
- Onboarding funnel analytics widget (joined → welcomed → verified → engaged → left)
- SSE live joins feed (Redis live-bus → dashboard SSE → React widget)
- "Test on me" button fires full welcome sequence on authenticated user

### Shared
- `JoinEvent` model with funnel `stages[]`, quarantine, verification, priorJoins
- `WelcomeConfig` extended with channel/role IDs, feature toggles, `themePreset`
- `redis.rawPublish/rawSubscribe` for ad-hoc bus channels

`pnpm -r build` passes with 0 errors, `pnpm lint` exits 0 (warnings only — pre-existing).
